title: The merge tool refuses a reason flag that holds a GitHub closing keyword before a PR number
why: Text that a reason flag puts in the merge commit can close an unmerged PR on GitHub.
note: Coordinator, 03:48 CST Nov 9. Incident: at 03:37 CST batch 67's --base-red-ok reason "Fix #2390" made GitHub close #2390 unmerged; runner 8 reopened it at 03:58 CST. Fix: merge/merge.py refuses --base-red-ok, and any other flag whose text lands in the merge commit, when it holds close, closes, closed, fix, fixes, fixed, resolve, resolves or resolved before #N. The coordinator starts it. Lane session_013NEJL3115C7kVTQidSxvGj (coordinator 03:49 CST Nov 9).
